narrative: During this period, joostlek merged fewer PRs and changed significantly fewer lines of code, while increasing the number of reviews given. The reduction in merged PR output accompanied a shift toward code review activities, with reviews rising while PR volume dropped.
root_cause_hypothesis: Time moved to reviewing rather than authoring PRs.

Reviews given increased during the same period
